New here?

Your first Sunday,
made simple.

Visiting a new church can feel unfamiliar. Here is everything you need to feel right at home at First Baptist Church, Kajo-Keji.

No perfect words
required.
03What to expect

We saved you
a seat.

01

Easy arrival. Parking and bicycle spaces are located right beside the main compound with accessible entry near the front doors.

02

Wear what feels like you. Traditional attire, casual clothes, Sunday best—we mean it when we say come as you are.

03

Look for our welcome team. A host will be at the front entrance to greet you, answer questions, and help you find a seat.
